asr.full_text: In Today's Video, we will be discussing technical support interview questions and answers which are used for very large MNCs In today's video sessions we will be covering these questions First question is about Latest Processes which are used in most of the companies and tell me about them So, in Intel Pentium Series Intel Pentium is launched currently in Quad Core core i3, i5, i7, and the latest market i9 has just launched. So these are the processors that are recently in market. second question is about 8085, which is an 8 BIT processor so why is it called 8 BIT basically the reason behind so this has eight bit arithmetical logic unit processing here there are eight bits operations because of that these processors called as eight bit processors so many times we ask this simple question in the interview but its a very important question, guys about processors you can ask about those processors so you can know what exactly micro-processors are and what are microprocessors So give your answers specifically in this sentence that microprocessor is a program control device here program control device are called as microprocessor you can ask about DSCP So what is DSCP We now call this OS to the Micro Process Let's discuss about DSCP DSCP is the full form of dynamic host configuration protocol This network protocol through which, systems and computers get IP Now we have some basic questions What is the difference between RJ45 RG11 and RJ45 RG11 you should know the basic difference here RJ45 is used for LAN and Internet connectivity And RJ 11 is used for all analog connections Now we can ask about DRAM types so you have to tell that DRAM types are SRAM, VRAM, SGRAM, DDR, SDRAM so these are the types of RAM which are DRAAM so basically we can see SSD and SDD HHD and SSD these are the basic hard disks Next question is what is caching memory? You can ask questions about caching memory. Here answers are given. Caching memory is memory between processors and RAM. Which is used to increase processing power. Where as much storage is there. If storage is going out of RAM and caching memory is good. Then the speed of your process is increased. Next question is, what is ping command? Ping command is used to check the connectivity between two computers through the IP address and hostname. Basically, the two computers are connected or not or internal communication is happening, to check this we use ping command. What is appipa? Computers get ip through dhcp in that case, if dhcp has no ability to get ip then you get api pa ip which range is 169254 series in this when you purchase a computer you get to know about the specifications which are the specifications when buying computer so what all are the specifications through which the system are different from each other you can ask the questions of computer specifications the answer can be given by the processor which is the latest processor used in the computer which is RAM and storage which is SDD or SSD or which is a manufacturing company or display size the display quality It defined them all in computer specification That's all for today's video So I hope you have learned the basic questions about Tech Support, Help Desk, Desktop support and can crack these interviews Thank you so much for watching this Video Bye...Bye...Take Care
